headline: A 1994 executive order by President Clinton barred certain financial and trade dealings involving Haiti.
what_it_does: This order banned certain kinds of transactions connected to Haiti. Based on the title alone, it limited what deals people and companies under US rules could make involving Haiti. The specific transactions covered are not described in the information provided.

who_it_affects.group: US businesses and individuals dealing with Haiti
who_it_affects.how: They were barred from making certain kinds of transactions involving Haiti.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 21, 1994; the exact effective date is not stated in the information provided.
